title: oncocalyx bolusii
intro: Oncocalyx bolusii, commonly known as the Bolus's Oncocalyx, is a plant species within the family Scrophulariaceae. This plant is traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering various health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial activities, which help in soothing sore throats and reducing fever. The therapeutic actions of Oncocalyx bolusii include its analgesic, anti-oxidant, and anti-spasmodic properties, which help in alleviating pain, reducing oxidative stress, and relaxing muscles. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties and health benefits.
